title: Preserving Conservation Laws in the Time-Evolving Natural Gradient Method via Relaxation and Projection Techniques
summary: Neural networks have demonstrated significant potential in solving partial differential equations (PDEs). While global approaches such as Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer promising capabilities, they often lack inherent temporal causality, which can limit their accuracy and stability for time-dependent problems. In contrast, local training frameworks that progressively update network parameters over time are naturally suited for evolving PDEs.
